game_title: Type Cast Forge – Lava Tube Tunnel Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round, lava imps strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel: keep the forge_heat meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: forge_heat drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while forge_heat > 0.
